item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
What's new

  • Work together any time: ask a friend if you can join them, or invite them to join you. No focus round needed.
  • Up to five people per session. Your pets sit at their desks side by side until someone leaves.
  • Joining a friend who is in a focus round starts the same round for you, and their pet tells you when they start a new one.
